visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a brightly lit retail shop or game center, a man wearing a white Adidas baseball cap and a black-and-white striped t-shirt sits closely next to a young boy in a pink t-shirt. They are positioned in front of a colorful, rainbow-themed pinball-style gaming machine decorated with cartoon characters. The background features yellow walls and shelves stocked with various boxed toys and gadgets. (2) The young boy excitedly pounds on the gaming machine's yellow frame with both hands. His facial expression is one of pure joy, characterized by a wide, open-mouthed smile and squinted eyes. The man beside him leans in, smiling broadly and watching the boy's progress on the game screen with an amused and supportive gaze. (3) A young girl in a grey t-shirt stands behind the two, looking over their shoulders and clapping her hands. The boy leans forward, pressing his face close to the glass window of the machine to watch the small metal balls move. Bright, colorful Traditional Chinese text overlays appear frequently in the center and bottom of the frame. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the machine's pink plastic collection tray, where dozens of small, reflective silver pinballs are rapidly cascading from an internal dispenser. The boy's small hand is visible on the machine's edge as he watches the accumulation. The lighting in the shop is even and warm, emphasizing the vibrant colors of the toys and machines. (5) The boy raises both of his arms high in the air, celebrating a win with a triumphant facial expression. The man laughs and pats the boy on the back, while the girl in the background continues to cheer. The camera captures these quick, high-energy movements with stable handheld filming. (6) The man leans down and kisses the boy on the cheek in a warm, fatherly gesture. The boy continues to smile widely, eyes fixed back on the machine. Multiple shots show the machine's numerical display updating with each win. (7) The video concludes with a final sequence of the boy and man playing together, their faces lit by the glow of the machine. The boy is seen intensely focusing on his next move while the man provides constant verbal encouragement and guidance through pointing and gestures.
